meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成首次设置,跑通核心流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚拿到 omo,不知道第一步该做什么。
copy.tagline_en: Finish first-time setup and run through the core workflow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just got omo and don't know the first step.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在新用户第一次对话时当向导，按顺序走六条流程：功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古、价值测算、记忆记录（贯穿全程）、首次会话的 init-deep 提议。其中三条为可选，用户拒绝就直接跳过。它会用你的语言作答。
howto.when: 当新用户提出想上手 omo 时触发。它只自动启动一次；之后可用 `senpi --onboard` 手动唤回。

say.text: 我是第一次用 omo，带我走一遍上手流程
say.note: 会从功能导览开始逐条推进

say.text: 我原来用 Claude Code，帮我把配置迁过来
say.note: 先给迁移方案，等你点头才动手

say.text: 帮我翻翻以前的会话，估一下能省多少
say.note: 需你同意翻查会话后才做估算

howto.what_en: On a new user's first conversation, Claude guides six lanes: feature tour, migration, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording, and a first-session init-deep proposal. Three lanes are opt-in; refusals are skipped.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts only once; the user can bring it back with the `senpi --onboard` flag.

say_en.text: I'm new to omo — walk me through the onboarding flow.
I come from Claude Code; carry my setup over.
say_en.note: Shows a migration plan and waits for your OK.

say_en.text: Look through my past sessions and estimate the savings.
